bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for intersection improvements at Trunk Highway 65 and Anoka County Road 60 in the city of Ham Lake.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; INTERSECTION IN HAM LAKE. +]

[+$2,273,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to the city of Ham Lake for construction of intersection safety improvements at marked Trunk Highway 65 and Anoka County Road 60 in the city of Ham Lake, including construction and realignment of associated frontage and backage roads. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for intersection improvements at Trunk Highway 65 and Anoka County Road 60 in the city of Ham Lake.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; INTERSECTION IN HAM LAKE.

$2,273,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to the city of Ham Lake for construction of intersection safety improvements at marked Trunk Highway 65 and Anoka County Road 60 in the city of Ham Lake, including construction and realignment of associated frontage and backage roads. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.
additions: $2,273,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to the city of Ham Lake for construction of intersection safety improvements at marked Trunk Highway 65 and Anoka County Road 60 in the city of Ham Lake, including construction and realignment of associated frontage and backage roads. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.
